claims.quote: Thirty-one DS-like patients(2.6%) harbored variants in nine genes: PCDH19 (9), GABRA1 (6), GABRB2 (4), GABRG2 (3), GABRB3 (1), HCN1 (3), SCN2A (1), TBC1D24 (2).

This study confirms SCN1A as the predominant genetic cause of DS, while identifying nine additional genes (PCDH19, GABRA1, GABRB2, GABRG2, GABRB3, HCN1, SCN2A, TBC1D24, and ALDH7A1) associated with DS-like phenotypes.
Oxcarbazepine exacerbated seizures in patients GABRG2, GABRB2 or GABRA1 variants.
